plan.title: Draft Publish Control Hidden When Vendor Lock Is Off

steps.note: Open the Events list as the buyer.
Enable eRFX projects for the draft flow.
Apply the setting under test so vendor addition remains unlocked during event creation.
Apply the case's required company configuration before opening the draft.
Confirm the events list rendered successfully before navigating to drafts.
Open the Drafts tab containing the saved eRFX draft.
Open the saved draft and land on its draft create screen.
Assert that Publish is not offered on the saved eRFX draft.
